title: 第11章 供奉心机妖娆女帝霸气护夫第12章 芳心触动欺负我男人不行魂兽秘辛
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
“老师，我想不明白，您临走前为何要赐予那小子龙血。”
马车内，神殿圣子煌焱皱着眉头询问，大手也没闲着，粗鲁按着谄媚女子的脑袋。
“嘶——”
四供奉眯着眸子，神情惬意道：“你明知那是怨龙毒为何要问，那小子胆敢服用必死无疑。”
“美滋滋的饮下本供奉赐予的‘宝物’，最后在痛苦哀嚎中崩的一声爆体而亡。”
煌焱眼神不屑：“老师若是看他不爽，随手宰了便是，那些平民烂命一条，何须浪费一瓶怨龙毒，他不配。”
“你懂什么？”四供奉摇头：“焱儿，你的天赋世上能与你匹敌者寥寥无几，但心计就太欠缺火候了。”
“不就是一个平民废物，倘若厌恶，杀了便是，又能怎样？”煌焱不以为然。
“你糊涂！”四供奉瞪眼：“杀一个平民容易，那其他人要不要杀？”
“倘若不杀其他人，女教皇便有可能得知咱们擅自杀害一个觉醒双生武魂的魂师，难免要追究起来，你又不是不知道，咱们这个女教皇，最在意平民性命。”
“倘若杀了，全村的人都死干净，势必会引起神殿追查，而分殿那边是知道咱们来过这里的，依然有可能存在麻烦。”
“赐予他龙血，既在平民面前展现了你我的仁慈大方，又能无声的除掉他，何不美哉？”
煌焱不解问道：“可是那小子不过是区区一个觉醒废武魂的蝼蚁罢了，难成大器，就算让他苟活于世又能怎样，您又何须理会？”
四供奉冷笑。
“你又怎知今日的蝼蚁，来日不会因为特殊机遇成为名震天下的强者？”
“那小子气宇轩昂，武魂虽废却透露着古怪，这种人提前处理掉，永绝后患才是最聪明的做法，何必给自己未来添麻烦？”
“就凭他，他也配？”煌焱放声大笑，擦了擦笑出的眼泪道：“老师，您太高看这些山野村夫了，哈哈哈。”
“我，煌焱，出身显赫，天资无双，日后自无敌于世间，横推一切牛鬼蛇神。”
“区区一介村民，何其卑微，无才无势，又算得上什么不得了的人物？”
四供奉摇头，劝告道：“焱儿，你嘴上可以蔑视敌人，但心里必须要重视一切敌人。”

“那小子其实勉强可以被我收为弟子，耗费大量资源未尝没有逆袭的机会，但你不仅是我徒弟，也是我儿子，我为何要耗费本该供给你的资源去培养别人？”
“但此子我又不想落在别人手里，尤其是女教皇那一派系，用一瓶怨龙毒轻松解决再好不过。”
煌焱摇头，眸中傲气丝毫不减，反倒愈发锋芒毕露。
“您老了，谨慎过头了。”
“只可惜那小子估计已经被怨龙毒折磨的哀嚎痛哭，爆体而亡，不然来日我必定亲手将之打爆，证明您今日的小心是多余的。”
四供奉苦笑：
“你欲谋求教皇之位，实力、心计缺一不可，女教皇那贱人手段铁血，惊才艳艳，可不好对付啊。”
煌焱脸上露出霸道邪魅的笑容。
“圣女很快就会被我征服到手。”
“女教皇？”
“呵，她也别想跑，也只有这样的女人才配得上我。”
content_en:
"Teacher, I don't understand why you gave that boy dragon blood before you left."
In the carriage, Huang Yan, the holy son of the temple, frowned and asked, his big hands were not idle, and he roughly pressed the head of the flattering woman.
"Hiss——"
The fourth priest squinted his eyes and said with a contented expression: "Why do you ask if you know clearly that it is Resentful Dragon Poison? That kid will definitely die if he dares to take it."
"He happily drank the 'treasure' given by this offering, and finally died with a loud explosion while screaming in pain."
Huang Yan's eyes were disdainful: "If the teacher doesn't like him, just kill him casually. Those civilians will die, so why waste a bottle of Resentful Dragon Poison? He doesn't deserve it."
"What do you know?" The fourth priest shook his head: "Yan'er, there are very few people in the world who can match your talent, but your scheming is too lacking."
"Isn't he just a civilian trash? If you hate him, you can just kill him, so what?" Huang Yan disagreed.
"You're confused!" The four priests glared: "It's easy to kill a civilian, but do you want to kill others?"
"If we don't kill other people, the female pope may learn that we killed a soul master who awakened the twin martial souls without authorization, and it will inevitably be investigated. It's not like you don't know that we, the female pope, care about the lives of civilians the most."
"If we kill him, everyone in the village will be dead, which will definitely trigger an investigation by the temple. And the branch temple knows that we have been here, so there may still be trouble."
"Giving him dragon blood not only shows your kindness and generosity in front of the common people, but also can get rid of him silently. Why not?"
Huang Yan asked in confusion: "But that kid is just an ant who has awakened the useless martial spirit. He is unlikely to become a great weapon. Even if he is allowed to live in the world, what will happen? Why should you care?"
The four worshippers sneered.
"How do you know that today's ants will not become world-famous strong men due to special opportunities in the future?"
"That boy has a majestic spirit, and although his martial spirit is useless, he is still weird. It is the smartest way to deal with this kind of person in advance and avoid future troubles. Why bother yourself in the future?"
"Just him, is he worthy?" Huang Yan laughed loudly, wiped the tears from his laughter and said, "Teacher, you think too highly of these mountain villagers, hahaha."
"I, Huang Yan, have a distinguished family background and unparalleled talent. I will be invincible in the world and overthrow all monsters and monsters."
"How can a mere villager be so humble, without talent or power, and how can he be considered such a great person?"
Si Zongfang shook his head and advised: "Yan'er, you can despise the enemy with your mouth, but you must pay attention to all enemies in your heart."
"That kid can barely be accepted as my disciple. After spending a lot of resources, there is no chance of counterattack. But you are not only my disciple, but also my son. Why should I spend the resources that should be provided to you to train others?"
"But I don't want this son to fall into the hands of others, especially the female pope's faction. It would be best to easily solve it with a bottle of resentful dragon poison."
Huang Yan shook his head, the arrogance in his eyes not diminishing at all, but becoming more sharp.
"You are old and overly cautious."
"It's a pity that the boy was probably tormented by the Resentful Dragon Poison and burst into tears. Otherwise, I will blow him up with my own hands one day, proving that your caution today is unnecessary."
The four worshippers smiled bitterly:
"If you want to seek the position of pope, you must have both strength and scheming. That bitch of the female pope is iron-blooded and stunningly talented. It's not easy to deal with her."
Huang Yan had a domineering and evil smile on his face.
"The Saint will soon be conquered by me."
"The female pope?"
"Oh, don't even think about running away. Only a woman like this is worthy of me."
